Join our Smart Robotics & Physical AI team as a Robotics Integration Engineer (x|f|m) and help drive the adoption of Intelligent Robotics and Physical AI across our global manufacturing sites. In this role, you will contribute to the integration of intelligent, adaptive and scalable robotics solutions into existing production environments and support the evolution of seamless collaboration between humans and machines.
Working closely with business functions, engineering teams and external partners, you will develop, implement and optimize innovative automation and robotics solutions that improve quality, ergonomics and operational efficiency while contributing to better health for more people.
Based in Goettingen with the possibility to work some days in a week remotely.

Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities

Develop, test and implement robotics and automation solutions that support intelligent manufacturing processes
Design, integrate and validate end effectors, sensors, vision systems and other robotics components for industrial applications
Develop and optimize robotic work cells, fixtures and automation solutions with a focus on performance, safety and scalability
Create and adapt technical designs and engineering data and support prototyping, testing and commissioning activities
Implement and integrate interfaces between robots, PLC systems and existing production equipment and support connectivity across industrial control environments
Analyze technical data and system performance, identify optimization opportunities and implement engineering improvements to enhance process and equipment performance
Support the integration of robotics and production systems using industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, PROFINET and EtherCAT
Contribute to the integration of production and robotics data into enterprise IT systems, data platforms and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
Support the implementation of Industrial IoT and edge computing architectures to improve connectivity, transparency and data utilization
Develop and implement safety concepts for human-robot collaboration and support validation and CE conformity activities
Investigate technical issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions to ensure reliable and efficient production operations
Document technical findings, engineering results and project progress and communicate recommendations to relevant stakeholders





What Will Convince Us

Degree in Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a comparable discipline
Several years of experience in the integration, commissioning and optimization of industrial automation or robotics solutions
Strong knowledge of PLC programming according to IEC 61131-3 and experience with industrial fieldbus technologies such as PROFINET and EtherCAT
Experience working with industrial robots and cobots, such as ABB, Universal Robots, FANUC, KUKA or comparable systems
Experience integrating and programming robotics solutions within existing manufacturing environments
Experience with industrial sensors, machine vision systems and 2D/3D camera technologies is an advantage
Basic knowledge of 3D CAD systems such as SolidWorks, Inventor or comparable solutions
Practical experience with OPC UA, MQTT and the integration of IT and OT environments
Basic knowledge of Python, C# or comparable programming languages is an advantage
Knowledge of machine safety, functional safety and CE conformity requirements
Experience in regulated manufacturing environments, such as GMP, pharmaceutical or medical technology industries, is an advantage
Strong analytical skills and experience applying structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis methodologies
Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to a variety of stakeholders
Fluent English




What We Offer

As a growing global life science company, stock listed on the MDAX and TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of Benefits:

Personal and Professional Development: Mentoring, leadership programs, Talent Talks, internal seminar offerings
Work Life Balance: Remote options, flextime, flexible work schedules, sabbaticals, Workation
Attractive Compensation: Vacation and holiday bonuses including pension benefits with a 35 hr. week and 30 vacation days
Large, Modern Campus: Open office spaces, terraces, company restaurant with vegetarian and vegan options, cozy Italian bistro with ice cream sales, fitness studio and daycare center
Making An Impact Right From The Start: Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform even before joining, Welcome Workshops, "buddy" as point of contact
Travel Benefits: car leasing, bike leasing, large free parking garage, good bus connections
This position is filled within the Sartorius Stedim Biotech GmbH.



We promote diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from people of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religions, age groups, disabilities, and cultural backgrounds.

About Sartorius 

Sartorius is part of the solution in the fight against cancer, dementia, and many other diseases. Our technologies help translate scientific discoveries into real-world medicine faster, so that new therapeutics can reach patients worldwide. 

We look for ambitious team players and creative minds, who want to contribute to this goal and advance their careers in a dynamic global environment.

Join our global team and become part of the solution. We are looking forward to receiving your application.
